question: When Regulus-san halts time for himself, do his organs other than his heart stop as well?
answer:
As for Regulus-san, while his heart is stopped, ALL of his organs are stopped.
Regulus-san's Authority of "Greed" is fundamentally an Authority of "Unchangeability" that "halts an object's time and forbids any alteration."
If he applies this Unchangeability to an object, it becomes a weapon capable of demolishing anything. If he applies it to himself, he becomes that way himself. However, there is a restriction that his heart cannot be stopped without killing him, so he entrusts his heart to others while the rest of his body remains under the effect of "Unchangeability."
When his heart returns to his own body, his "Unchangeability" on himself can only last for the few seconds he can stop his heart without dying. Furthermore, because he has to focus entirely on himself, everything else gets neglected, making his control of "Unchangeability" used for offense sloppy. In the end, he has no choice but to repeatedly stop and restart his own heart while focusing entirely on defense.
